title: Squinting Harder
summary: Teaching a $100 SO-101 arm long, multi-stage tasks from a 16×16 pixel camera, with flow matching, Q-chunking, and one small change to the critic.

title: Autodidactic Iteration: Learning Backwards from the Goal
